mapper.select: SELECT J.id, J.company_member_id, COALESCE(J.company_name, C.company_name) AS company_name, J.title, J.job_category, J.employment_type, J.location, J.salary_min, J.work_type, J.experience_level, J.education_level, J.description, J.requirements, J.preferred_qualifications, J.accessibility_info, J.wheelchair_accessible, J.accessible_restroom, J.disabled_parking, J.rest_area_available, J.elevator_available, J.assistive_device_support, J.deadline, J.status, J.created_at, J.updated_at FROM job_posting J, company_profile C WHERE J.company_member_id = C.member_id AND J.status = 'OPEN' AND (J.deadline IS NULL OR J.deadline >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY J.created_at DESC, J.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT J.id, J.company_member_id, COALESCE(J.company_name, C.company_name) AS company_name, J.title, J.job_category, J.employment_type, J.location, J.salary_min, J.work_type, J.experience_level, J.education_level, J.description, J.requirements, J.preferred_qualifications, J.accessibility_info, J.wheelchair_accessible, J.accessible_restroom, J.disabled_parking, J.rest_area_available, J.elevator_available, J.assistive_device_support, J.deadline, J.status, J.created_at, J.updated_at FROM job_posting J, company_profile C WHERE J.company_member_id = C.member_id AND J.id = #{id} AND J.status != 'DELETED'

SELECT J.id, J.company_member_id, COALESCE(J.company_name, C.company_name) AS company_name, J.title, J.job_category, J.employment_type, J.location, J.salary_min, J.work_type, J.experience_level, J.education_level, J.description, J.requirements, J.preferred_qualifications, J.accessibility_info, J.wheelchair_accessible, J.accessible_restroom, J.disabled_parking, J.rest_area_available, J.elevator_available, J.assistive_device_support, J.deadline, J.status, J.created_at, J.updated_at FROM job_posting J, company_profile C WHERE J.company_member_id = C.member_id AND J.company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND J.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY J.created_at DESC, J.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_posting ( company_member_id, company_name, title, job_category, employment_type, location, salary_min, work_type, experience_level, education_level, description, requirements, preferred_qualifications, accessibility_info, wheelchair_accessible, accessible_restroom, disabled_parking, rest_area_available, elevator_available, assistive_device_support, deadline, status ) VALUES ( #{companyMemberId}, #{companyName}, #{title}, #{jobCategory}, #{employmentType}, #{location}, #{salaryMin}, #{workType}, #{experienceLevel}, #{educationLevel}, #{description}, #{requirements}, #{preferredQualifications}, #{accessibilityInfo}, #{wheelchairAccessible}, #{accessibleRestroom}, #{disabledParking}, #{restAreaAvailable}, #{elevatorAvailable}, #{assistiveDeviceSupport}, NULLIF(#{deadline}, ''), 'OPEN' )
mapper.update: UPDATE job_posting SET company_name = #{companyName}, title = #{title}, job_category = #{jobCategory}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, location = #{location}, salary_min = #{salaryMin}, work_type = #{workType}, experience_level = #{experienceLevel}, education_level = #{educationLevel}, description = #{description}, requirements = #{requirements}, preferred_qualifications = #{preferredQualifications}, accessibility_info = #{accessibilityInfo}, wheelchair_accessible = #{wheelchairAccessible}, accessible_restroom = #{accessibleRestroom}, disabled_parking = #{disabledParking}, rest_area_available = #{restAreaAvailable}, elevator_available = #{elevatorAvailable}, assistive_device_support = #{assistiveDeviceSupport}, deadline = NULLIF(#{deadline}, ''), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE job_posting SET status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE job_posting SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND status != 'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM job_posting WHERE status != 'DELETED'
